name: Tanapak Jongjaiphar
bio: Tanapak Jongjaiphar is an actor and musician. He graduated from Thammasat University.

credits.title: VIVANT
roles: チョッキー・テーパーニット

credits.title: Will You Marry Monk?
credits.overview: When a Thai monk fights with a Japanese monk as a brother-in-law, even though this is not the monk’s duty, the monk has to get involved because his young sister wants to marry a monk, which is impossible!

credits.title: RedLife
credits.overview: Som, daughter of a sex worker, believes that love will lead her towards a better life. Ter, a young criminal, robs just to buy love that doesn't exist. Redlife explores a world that is broken, ignored, and which offers no escape.

credits.title: Nemesis
credits.overview: A former psychiatric patient seeks vengeance and aims to take down a gang of underworld criminals after a tragic accident sees his beloved family killed.

credits.title: Pay It Forward
credits.overview: Recopilation of four short films inspired by 'His Majesty King Rama IX' to pass on and nourish the hearts of Thai people throughout the country. directed by different directors.
